dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Just barely, though.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: But your body really is weird.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: What the hell is the deal with you?!

dialogue.speech: Y-Y-You copycat!

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: He's meters ahead and to my left.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Just seven more meters...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Five meters...

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.speech: Or what?

dialogue.name: Secco

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.speech: What is this sound?
